Parsley
should be chosen.  Fresh parsley can be
wrapped in damp paper towels and stored
in an open plastic bag in the refrigerator
for up to 1 week.
The curly-leaved varieties of parsley
are used as a flavoring, a salad ingredient,
and a garnish.  Flat-leaved parsley, with
its stronger flavor, is frequently used as a
seasoning in Italian cooking.  Dried
parsley may be substituted for the fresh
herb by using one-third of the amount
of the fresh herb specified by the recipe.
Nutrient composition
A serving of parsley contains some
vitamin C.

Varieties
Unlike their cousins the carrots, parsnips
are not bred for variety of color or shape,
and the number of varieties is small.
Modern varieties are bred to grow a fat,
wedge-shaped root.  The most disease-
resistant types are the Gladiator, a sweet,
early-maturing parsnip, the Avonresister,
and the Andover, a new American variety.
The most popular parsnip is the All
American, which has broad “shoulders,”
white flesh, and a tender core.
